plugin.description: Control Spotify from Stream Deck: playback, like, album/artist.
plugin.requirements: Spotify Premium recommended; Redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:41837/callback in Dashboard.

Favourite.description: Like / unlike current track (Library or StreamDeck Likes playlist).

PlayAlbum.description: Play an album by name, Spotify URL or URI (configure on the key).

PlayArtist.description: Play an artist by name, Spotify URL or URI (configure on the key).
